description: City of Toronto publishes the delineation of areas served by the same local sewer infrastructure (sanitary subsewersheds) used for the basement flooding studies, described as updated on a continual daily basis to support development pre-application discussions and servicing reports. Coverage: the City of Toronto; the record was last modified on 2026-02-20. Format and access: GeoJSON, CSV, Shapefile, GeoPackage, downloadable without registration from the City of Toronto Open Data portal; the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Open Government Licence - Toronto, as shown on the dataset page (the CKAN API licence field reads "License not specified"); cost: free. Caveats: the layer holds area boundaries, not sewer pipes, flood depths or claims; the page carries an as-is no-warranty statement; the CKAN API licence field does not carry the Open Government Licence - Toronto shown on the pages; the files were not opened; two companion datasets on the portal cover flood reports by district and basement flooding by ward. Simulation uses: sewershed-level boundaries for urban drainage and basement-flood risk models and for servicing capacity checks in growth areas. Related catalogue records: Urban Form Toronto: built environment and walkability measures on a 100 m hexagon grid (data-toronto-urban-form-hex-measures); City of Toronto watermain breaks 1990 to 2016 (data-toronto-watermain-breaks); OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
